subject: Acme - Renewal & Expansion recap
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Hayes <jordan.hayes@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Acme - Renewal & Expansion recap

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for taking the time today — really appreciated the candid conversation about where Acme is with Redwood today and what you need for the next 12 months. Below is a quick recap to make sure we’re aligned and to surface next steps.

Key pain points discussed:
- Cost volatility on high-throughput embedding jobs (search index refreshes) — spikes during batch updates.
- Latency for synchronous customer-facing generation during peak ETL windows (~700ms p50 currently).
- Limited visibility into per-team token costs; procurement wants clearer reporting.

Goals & priorities for renewal/expansion:
- Lock in predictable pricing for embeddings workload and add a reserved pool for nightly batch jobs.
- Improve p50 latency to <400ms for critical generation routes (customer chat) via dedicated capacity + smarter batching.
- Provide a cost dashboard and monthly allocation reports for Finance.

Proposed upsell path & timeline:
1) Q1 2027: Purchase Dedicated Reservation (50 GPU-hours/day baseline) for embeddings batch window.
2) Q1–Q2 2027: Pilot dedicated pool for chat generation with a 30-day performance SLO evaluation.
3) By renewal date (2027-03-31): Convert pilot to full committed capacity + updated SLO in contract.

Action items / owners:
- Redwood -> share MAP, pricing quote, and usage report (Marissa) — target: Monday 12/7.
- Acme -> confirm procurement contact and preferred PO process (Jordan / Aisha) — target: 12/8.
- Redwood -> set up short follow-up demo for the dedicated routing and batching config (Rishi) — target: week of 12/13.

Attachments I’ll send in a follow-up with the MAP and usage export. If any of the priorities above aren’t captured correctly, please flag. Otherwise, I’ll get the documents over and we can lock a demo time.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0142

---
Redwood Inference — making inference predictable and economical

From: Jordan Hayes <jordan.hayes@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Roy <aisha.roy@acme.com>, Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2026 17:18:00 -0600
Subject: Re: Acme - Renewal & Expansion recap

Thanks Marissa — that matches our notes. A few quick clarifications: 

- For the embeddings batch, the peak cost events are concentrated in a 3-hour window overnight; we’d like the reserved pool to cover that and avoid on-demand spikes.
- For the chat p50 target, can you confirm how you’ll measure this (route-level p50 vs global)? We’d prefer route-level metrics tied to the customer chat endpoint.

Procurement: Aisha Roy is our billing/procurement owner — I’ve CC’d her. Our PO process requires a formal quote and standard terms; we can route to procurement once we have the quote and MAP.

We’re available for a demo the week of 12/13 — morning PT works best. Looking forward to the MAP and usage export.

Jordan
Head of AI Platforms | Acme Corporation
jordan.hayes@acme.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Hayes <jordan.hayes@acme.com>; Aisha Roy <aisha.roy@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 06 Dec 2026 00:12:00 +0000
Subject: Acme - MAP, usage report & quote (attachments)

Jordan / Aisha —

Attached: Redwood-MAP-Acme-20261205.pdf, acme-usage-report-202610.csv, redwood-pricing-quote-acme-20261205.xlsx. Quick notes: 

- MAP highlights: reserved pool sized to cover the 3-hr overnight window with 20% burst buffer; pilot configuration for chat routes includes route-level p50 instrumentation and a 30-day SLO evaluation.
- Usage report: includes token/embedding counts by project for Oct 2026 and an estimated trend for Q4.
- Quote: two options — a 12-month committed reservation (best unit economics) and a 6-month pilot (flexible). Pricing rows call out per-token and per-embedding unit, plus monthly reserved GPU fees.

Next steps I propose: 
1) You confirm procurement contact and preferred quote option (Aisha).
2) We schedule the demo for dedicated routing (Rishi to lead) — I’ve suggested Tue 12/14 10:00 AM PT and Thu 12/16 9:00 AM PT; please let me know which works.
3) If procurement wants standard terms edits, we’ll involve Legal early and aim to keep redlines minimal.

If you want a one-page summary for leadership, I can produce that as well.

Best,

Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood-MAP-Acme-20261205.pdf; acme-usage-report-202610.csv; redwood-pricing-quote-acme-20261205.xlsx

From: Jordan Hayes <jordan.hayes@acme.com>

Cc: Aisha Roy <aisha.roy@acme.com>, Procurement <procurement@acme.com>

Subject: Re: Acme - MAP, usage report & quote (attachments)

Received the docs — thanks Marissa. I’ll review with Procurement and aim to pick the 12-month commit if the pricing delta is close to the pilot option.

We prefer the Tue 12/14 10:00 AM PT demo. Please send a calendar invite. Also looping in our legal contact (procurement@acme.com) for visibility on terms.

Jordan
